title: IDOR in Barber Routes - GET /barbers/:id
description: The GET /api/v1/barbers/:id endpoint in the vulnerable API lacks any ownership or access validation. Any authenticated user (CUSTOMER, BARBER, or ADMIN) can access any barber's profile data by simply providing the barber's ID in the URL. The vulnerable implementation directly calls getBarber.execute with the provided ID without verifying that the requesting user is the barber themselves, an ADMIN, or a CUSTOMER with a valid relationship (e.g., having an appointment with that barber).
impact: Cross-barber data exfiltration. A malicious user can enumerate and access all barber profiles including names, phone numbers, specialties, hire dates, and active status by simply enumerating or guessing barber IDs.
mitigation: Implement ownership validation middleware (checkBarberAccess) that verifies the requesting user is either the barber themselves (barber.userId matches userId), an ADMIN, or a CUSTOMER with an existing appointment relationship with the barber. Compare with secure implementation in barber_routes_secure.md which uses checkBarberAccess middleware.
